# old-invocation-allowlist.txt — files that may still carry the old extension-builder
# invocation or name the deleted shared render library (spec 0254 R29).
# scripts/tests/extension-references.test.ts fails on any other tracked or untracked text
# file that tells a reader to run `bash scripts/<one of the five builders>.sh`, or names it.
#
# Format: one repo-relative path per line; an entry ending in `/` covers every file below that
# directory. Every entry carries a reason as the `#` comment line directly above it. An entry
# that no longer matches a file with a hit, or that appears twice, fails the suite.
# The five shims: their header and usage text name the invocation they keep working.
# The TypeScript check that replaced check-extension-manifest-version.sh keeps the shell script's
# diagnostic verbatim, which tells a reader to run the old builder invocation.
# Bash tests that have not migrated: each deliberately drives the shim or the shell oracle.
# Negative assertions: these suites name the deleted library to prove it is gone and unlisted.
# A frozen record of the original shell output (the shell quoted the old invocation in its diagnostics).
# Specifications are dated records of the requirement, including the old invocation.
specs/
# A dated evidence record under tests/ quoting the invocation it ran.
tests/gemini-extension-path-form.md
